name: Golden Rapture Mining Corporation
summary: Golden Rapture Mining Corporation engages in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties in Canada. The company explores for gold, silver, nickel, cobalt, copper, and zinc. Its flagship property is the Phillips Township gold property that consists of 225 claim cells covering an area of approximately 10,000 acres located in the New Gold Rainy River Gold Mine, NW Ontario. It has option agreement with Richard Loney and Terri-Lynn Henry to acquire 100% of the mineral rights to seven patented mineral claims located in Rainy River District of Ontario. The company was incorporated in 2022 and is headquartered in Edmonton, Canada.
